points.text: Trump said Iran could strike Los Angeles or San Diego, drawing condemnation from California leaders.
Trump approved a firing-squad execution for Nidal Hasan, convicted in the 2009 Fort Hood shooting; it would be the first U.S. military execution since 1961.
Kenya confirmed its first Ebola case after a traveler from the Democratic Republic of Congo died in Nairobi, and officials identified 28 contacts.
Former German foreign-intelligence chief August Hanning was arrested on suspicion of espionage and treason over alleged disclosures of classified information to a foreign power.
South Korean police are investigating cyberattacks that exposed bank customers’ information, while President Lee said AI may have been used.
